project_type: Cinematic investor pitch deck - vanilla JS particle universe experience
build_system: Vite (unused in development, no npm available)
test_framework: None - manual verification via AST/syntax parsing
build_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/scenes/Scene004_Ripple.js (syntax check each file)
test_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check on all new/modified files
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --check on every new/modified JS file. 2. Verify imports resolve to actual files. 3. Verify constants/settings referenced actually exist. 4. Verify class patterns match existing codebase (constructor, init, update, destroy lifecycle).
setup_instructions: No setup needed - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, no npm install possible. Use pre-installed Node.js v22.22.3 for syntax validation only.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm registry blocked. Cannot install dependencies. Must use NODE_OPTIONS='' prefix for all node commands. All validation is AST/syntax based.
contribution_requirements: No function > ~60 lines, no class > ~400 lines. Zero allocations in render/update loops. Object pooling. Everything modular, configurable, deterministic. No magic numbers. Think like a cinematographer - timing between events matters more than events themselves. Silence, restraint, anticipation are features.
key_patterns: 1. Classes follow MANAGER_STATES lifecycle (UNINITIALIZED->READY->DESTROYED). 2. Scenes have getId/setUniverse/load/enter/update/leave/destroy. 3. BehaviorSystem uses register/enable/disable with apply(particle, dt, elapsed, ctx). 4. SceneDirector uses phase arrays with {id, startTime, duration, onEnter, onUpdate, onLeave}. 5. Settings are Object.freeze'd. 6. Constants are exported frozen objects. 7. ConnectionManager exposes getConnectedParticles() and getConnectionState(). 8. Engine.js has initSceneNNN/transitionToSceneNNN pattern. 9. AudioArchitecture registerEvent/emit pattern for future hooks. 10. Pre-allocated result objects to avoid per-frame allocations.
directory_structure: js/config/ (constants, settings), js/engine/ (Engine, SceneDirector, CinematicTimeline, SceneManager), js/engine/universe/ (all subsystems), js/scenes/ (Scene001-003, with scene00N/ subdirs for phases), js/utils/ (helpers, math, Noise, dom), css/ (styling)
